title: NexaCorp Recon Console
wrong_answer_message: Not the flag yet - check every open port carefully, not just the interesting-looking ones.

hints.text: The common-ports preset (1-1024) won't cover every port a service could be running on.
One open port is a decoy that says so directly in its banner. Keep scanning wider.
Port 31337's banner mentions an account left enabled on another service. Where else on this host could you use it?
SSH is open on port 22. Once you're in, look at what's in the home directory.
